title: What is known about 1RB0RD_1LC1LB_---1LD_1RA0RE_1RD0LF_1LE0LD
description: Proof status of the six-state BB(6) holdout 1RB0RD_1LC1LB_---1LD_1RA0RE_1RD0LF_1LE0LD.
intro: Nobody knows whether this six-state machine halts from blank tape. This page describes what its run looks like at the level of words and counters, what a halt would need, and what is still missing. The description comes from simulation (first look, about an hour of study); nothing beyond the bounded runs is proved.
verdict: The question is open. Lean proves no halt in the first 107 steps, the C simulator none in 109. The macro structure described below is observed in the simulation, not proved.

claims.title: The halting configurations
claims.text: The machine stops exactly when it reads the symbol of a halting transition (C0); the generated statement covers every configuration.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10,000 steps
claims.text: The list simulator of the shared library, proved to agree with the machine's semantics, runs 10,000 steps from blank tape without a halt, evaluated by Lean's kernel.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>7</sup> steps
claims.text: The same run, evaluated by compiled code.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>9</sup> steps
claims.text: The C simulator tools/c/triage.c runs 109 steps without a halt; at the end 411,553 cells have been visited and 206,609 of them hold a 1.

claims.title: Growth shape: fixed/linear
claims.text: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape stopped growing in the second half of the run (bounded so far, or growing so slowly that no record fell in the last half). Right of the start it grows in proportion to the step count (the head drifts steadily that way) (fitted exponent 0.92).

claims.title: A row of pair counters
claims.text: At the left-end samples in state E the tape is a long run of 10 pairs, two markers 1^2 0, a second long run, and then shorter runs of pairs separated by markers 1^2 0 or 1 0^2 (observed up to 2·10<sup>7</sup> steps).

claims.title: Shift rules, for every n
claims.text: D crosses (10)^n to the right and leaves (01)^n; E crosses (01)^n and leaves (10)^n; A crosses (10)^n and leaves (01)^n.

claims.title: A six-step counter at the left end
claims.text: At each visit in state F to the left end, the tape reads F>0 0 a^n X Y W (a = 10, P = 110, Q = 100), and (X, Y) runs through (P,P), (Q,P), (P,Q), (Q,Q), (P,aP), (Q,aP), with n going up by 1 at each step and by 2 at the last. In the first 109 steps 981 transitions follow the cycle (164 full cycles) and 4 do not (all at the start, n ≤ 4); the last sample has n = 1151.

claims.title: Size of the tape description (family screen)
claims.text: At the 4 records between 2.6·10<sup>8</sup> and 1.6·10<sup>10</sup> steps (first new leftmost or rightmost cell after each threshold 10<sup>6</sup>·4^k) the tape has 114,381 to 6,668,265 visited cells and compresses to 6,654 to 387,336 level-2 tokens (repeats of a word of at most 40 cells, then repeats of groups of such tokens).

claims.title: Proposed family: F11, defect gases and irregular zones
claims.text: This machine stopped being a bouncer early in the run. The last new cell on the left (cell −1,973) was reached before step 6.4·107, and since then the head has stayed near the right end: in the eight successive doublings of the step count from 6.4·107 to 1.6·1010 its greatest distance from the rightmost visited cell was 19,277, 24,350, 25,882, 29,767, 35,564, 39,489, 41,342 and 37,190 cells (c/front.c), while the right end moved from cell 54,852 to cell 6,666,290, in proportion to the steps (about 0.4 cells per 1,000 steps). What is left behind is frozen and does not compress: 24,137, 96,613 and 387,336 level-2 tokens at 109, 4.1·109 and 1.6·1010 steps for 419,103, 1,661,759 and 6,668,265 cells (one token per 17 cells each time). It is runs (10)^k and (01)^k with k mostly below 40, separated by single cells. The first 4,400 cells ((10)^1153 111 (01)^1054 …) are the same at the three records. So the description is not bounded and the tape is not a list that is swept: it is an irregular sea written once by a zone of some tens of thousands of cells at the right end. F11. The zone itself is where a proof would have to work; its depth grew by a factor of about 2 while the tape grew by a factor of about 120.

claims.title: Does it halt from blank tape?
claims.text: Not known. No macro rule has been proved for this machine yet; see the README's Later section for the next steps.

explainer.lede: Nobody knows yet. The tape is a row of counters made of 10 pairs, separated by two kinds of markers, behind a long run of pairs that keeps growing.

facts.text: two long runs of 10 pairs grow; shorter counters follow
No halt in the C simulator; 411,553 cells visited.
No halt, proved in Lean; the first 10,000 by the kernel alone.

sections.heading: A row of pair counters
html: Write a for the pair 1 0. Each time the head is at the left end in state E, the tape reads E>1 a^N 1^2 0 1^2 0 a^K 1^2 0 …: a long run of N pairs, two markers, a second long run of K pairs, and then many shorter runs of pairs, each followed by a marker 1^2 0 or 1 0^2. At step 2,157,249 N = 527 and K = 385; at step 19,526,315 N = 1,052 and K = 964.

So the tape looks like an array of counters, each a run of pairs, and the two kinds of markers look like a bit attached to each counter. The head sweeps the whole array; how one sweep changes the counters is not yet worked out.

sections.heading: What a halt would need
html: The machine halts when it reads a 0 in state C (C0 is the halting transition). C is entered from B on a 0 (B0 = 1LC), so a halt needs 0 B>0 reached moving left, which needs two adjacent 0s. Inside the word the only double 0s are in the markers 1 0^2.

sections.heading: The left-end counter
html: Sampled at the left end in state F, with a = 10, P = 110, Q = 100, the tape is F>0 0 a^n X Y W, and the markers X, Y run through a cycle of six, (P,P) → (Q,P) → (P,Q) → (Q,Q) → (P,aP) → (Q,aP) → (P,P), while n goes up by 7 per cycle. In 109 steps, 981 transitions follow it and 4 at the very start do not. The rest W also changes, so this is not a full map yet.

sections.heading: Which family it belongs to
html: The 22 machines of family F09 (“bouncers over lists of counters, not yet classified”) were screened in one way. The machine runs from blank tape for 2·1010 steps; each time the tape reaches a new cell after a threshold, the tape is compressed twice: first repeats of one word, then repeats of groups of words. If the tape is a few growing blocks and a bounded rest, the number of level-2 tokens stays bounded while the tape grows. Everything in this section is observed in one run. None of it is proved.
Proposed family: F11, defect gases and irregular zones (a working zone at the right end that moves right and leaves a frozen irregular sea behind).

This machine stopped being a bouncer early in the run. The last new cell on the left (cell −1,973) was reached before step 6.4·107, and since then the head has stayed near the right end: in the eight successive doublings of the step count from 6.4·107 to 1.6·1010 its greatest distance from the rightmost visited cell was 19,277, 24,350, 25,882, 29,767, 35,564, 39,489, 41,342 and 37,190 cells (c/front.c), while the right end moved from cell 54,852 to cell 6,666,290, in proportion to the steps (about 0.4 cells per 1,000 steps).

What is left behind is frozen and does not compress: 24,137, 96,613 and 387,336 level-2 tokens at 109, 4.1·109 and 1.6·1010 steps for 419,103, 1,661,759 and 6,668,265 cells (one token per 17 cells each time). It is runs (10)^k and (01)^k with k mostly below 40, separated by single cells. The first 4,400 cells ((10)^1153 111 (01)^1054 …) are the same at the three records.

So the description is not bounded and the tape is not a list that is swept: it is an irregular sea written once by a zone of some tens of thousands of cells at the right end. F11. The zone itself is where a proof would have to work; its depth grew by a factor of about 2 while the tape grew by a factor of about 120.
Next step. Describe the working zone: the tape within 50,000 cells of the right end at successive records, compressed, to see whether it is a counter of slowly growing length that is carried along.

sections.heading: The shape of the run
html: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape stopped growing in the second half of the run (bounded so far, or growing so slowly that no record fell in the last half). Right of the start it grows in proportion to the step count (the head drifts steadily that way) (fitted exponent 0.92).
After 109 steps the tape spans 411,553 cells (1,973 left of the start, 221,146 right), with a density of 1s of 0.502.
These are measurements of one bounded run, sorted by tools/py/bbtools/triage.py; the macro structure behind them is the next thing to find.

family: array of (10)-counters behind a growing (10) run
summary: A long run of 10 pairs on the left grows steadily; behind it the tape is a word of 10-pair counters separated by two kinds of markers, 1^2 0 and 1 0^2, rewritten by sweeps.
